coordinated_activities.activity: Sleeping, with the fan running to cope with the warm night
Waking up, using the toilet and taking a cool shower to start the day
Preparing and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle and making toast
Getting dressed, checking the heatwave warning on the phone and packing a water bottle and sun hat for the day
Commuting to the nonprofit community centre, walking to transport in the already hot morning air
Working as community program coordinator, setting up and running morning community programs and meeting with volunteers
Taking a lunch break in a cool indoor area near the centre, eating and rehydrating
Continuing work, coordinating afternoon programs, doing admin and checking in with partner organisations
Commuting home after work, stopping briefly to pick up groceries for dinner
Cooking and eating dinner using the induction cooker, keeping the range hood on
Clearing the table and loading the dishwasher
Relaxing in front of the TV with the air conditioner on, cooling down after the hot day
Taking a shower and completing evening hygiene routine
Winding down with the desk lamp on, using the computer and phone to plan tomorrow's programs before bed
Sleeping, with the fan running for air circulation through the hot night
